zone_name.title: Zone Name
zone_name.description: Specific zone to analyze (e.g., 'Paint Shop'), or omit/null for all zones. Valid zones: 'Stamping Shop', 'Body Shop (BIW)', 'Paint Shop', 'General Assembly', 'Powertrain Assembly', 'Quality Control', 'Logistics'

hours.title: Hours
hours.description: Hours of historical data to analyze (1-168)

query.title: Query
query.description: Natural language query about plant operations

examples.query: Why is Paint Shop showing red status?

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: Array of zone names to analyze. Must be a JSON array of strings. Valid zone names: 'Stamping Shop', 'Body Shop (BIW)', 'Paint Shop', 'General Assembly', 'Powertrain Assembly', 'Quality Control', 'Logistics'. To analyze ALL zones: omit this field entirely or set to null. DO NOT use the string 'all' - use null or omit the field.

zone_name.title: Zone Name
zone_name.description: Zone name to forecast energy consumption. Valid zones: 'Stamping Shop', 'Body Shop (BIW)', 'Paint Shop', 'General Assembly', 'Powertrain Assembly', 'Quality Control', 'Logistics'

hours_ahead.title: Hours Ahead
hours_ahead.description: Number of hours to forecast ahead (1-168)

current_temp.title: Current Temp
current_temp.description: Current temperature in °C (optional, uses latest if not provided)

current_efficiency.title: Current Efficiency
current_efficiency.description: Current efficiency percentage (optional, uses latest if not provided)

zone_name.title: Zone Name
zone_name.description: Zone name requiring maintenance. Valid zones: 'Stamping Shop', 'Body Shop (BIW)', 'Paint Shop', 'General Assembly', 'Powertrain Assembly', 'Quality Control', 'Logistics'

examples.issue: Oven temperature anomaly detected - 3 occurrences in 24h

line_id.title: Line Id
line_id.description: Unique identifier for the production line

name.title: Name
name.description: Descriptive name for the production line

production_capacity.title: Production Capacity
production_capacity.description: Production capacity in units per hour

simulation_name.title: Simulation Name
simulation_name.description: Descriptive name for this simulation scenario

modifications.title: Modifications
modifications.description: Array of zone modifications to simulate. Must be a JSON array. Each modification must include 'zone_name' and at least one parameter change (capacity_increase, temperature_offset, efficiency_modifier, energy_multiplier, or add_production_lines).

duration_hours.title: Duration Hours
duration_hours.description: Number of hours to simulate (1-168). Use 720 for 30-day simulation, 168 for 1-week simulation.

examples.simulation_name: Add second production line to Paint Shop
Reduce energy consumption in Body Shop

description.title: Description
examples: Test impact of reducing oven temperature by 10°C

zone_name.title: Zone Name
zone_name.description: Zone name to test. Valid zones: 'Stamping Shop', 'Body Shop (BIW)', 'Paint Shop', 'General Assembly', 'Powertrain Assembly', 'Quality Control', 'Logistics'

value_change.title: Value Change
value_change.description: Amount to change the parameter by (positive or negative). For temperature: degrees Celsius, For efficiency: percentage points, For energy: multiplier (e.g., -0.2 = 20% reduction)

examples.description: Test impact of reducing oven temperature by 10°C to save energy
Test impact of 5% efficiency improvement through automation

zone_name.title: Zone Name
zone_name.description: Name of the manufacturing zone to modify. Valid zones: 'Stamping Shop', 'Body Shop (BIW)', 'Paint Shop', 'General Assembly', 'Powertrain Assembly', 'Quality Control', 'Logistics'

temperature_offset.title: Temperature Offset
temperature_offset.description: Temperature change in °C (e.g., -10 to reduce by 10°C, +5 to increase by 5°C)

efficiency_modifier.title: Efficiency Modifier
efficiency_modifier.description: Efficiency percentage change (e.g., -5 for -5% efficiency, +3 for +3% efficiency)

energy_multiplier.title: Energy Multiplier
energy_multiplier.description: Energy usage multiplier as decimal (e.g., 1.5 for 50% increase, 0.8 for 20% reduction)

capacity_increase.title: Capacity Increase
capacity_increase.description: Production capacity increase as percentage (e.g., 50 for 50% increase when adding production lines, 100 for doubling capacity)

add_production_lines.title: Add Production Lines
add_production_lines.description: Array of production lines to add to the zone

remove_line_ids.title: Remove Line Ids
remove_line_ids.description: Array of line IDs to remove from the zone
